verdict: Paid ads are paused; organic visibility is the only active channel and fading.
narrative: This period, no budget ran on Meta or Google, meaning zero paid leads were generated across both channels. Your Google Business profiles carried all measurable activity — 182 total actions over 28 days — but that engagement fell 50% in the last 7 days versus the 7 days before, with the final three days of the period showing near-zero activity. Two of your three profiles also recorded no calls despite accumulating hundreds of impressions, pointing to a conversion issue at the listing level that is being addressed now. Ad spend is being reactivated and the Business profile listings are being reviewed this week to improve call-through before the next reporting period.
